name: m3l-claude-mentor
description: A Claude Code plugin that mentors one learner on Claude and Claude Code, adapting to their mastery level.

dial.title: Tip frequency
dial.description: How often the mentor adds a short tip: 0 is off, 1 is rare, 5 is most frequent. Default 2.

transcriptAnalysis.title: Observe usage
transcriptAnalysis.description: Let the mentor note which Claude Code features you use (feature names only, never content, stored locally). Default on.
